title.narrative: Technical Assistance to Ukraine Transport Connectivity - Phase 1

description.narrative: The Project consists of two phases. The first phase (Phase I) is designed to improve connectivity in the Eastern neighborhood, provide valuable support for Sub-Projects with significant positive impact locally, and help to realize Sub-Projects that can deliver tangible results for citizens. In addition, the investment is expected to improve road safety and have positive impact to economic development.
